entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 3659 of 2024

Applicant :- Narendra Saroha
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Shashank Maurya

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Rajneesh Kumar Mishra Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1. List has been revised.

2. Heard Sri Vivekanand Maurya, Advocate holding brief of Sri Shashank Maurya, learned counsel for applicant, Sri Rajneesh Kumar Mishra, learned counsel for the informant as well as Sri Pranshu Kumar, learned Additional Government Advocate for State.

3. The present application for anticipatory bail has been filed for protection in regard to Case Crime No.999 of 2023, under Sections 420, 406, 467, 468, 471, 506 I.P.C., Police Station- Loni, District- Ghaziabad.

entities.text: Narendra Saroha vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
After arguing for some time, applicant's counsel submits that the present application for anticipatory bail may be dismissed as withdrawn with a direction to file a regular bail application which may be decided keeping in view the guidelines as laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825.
5.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. has no objection to the prayer of learned counsel for the applicant.

6. After hearing learned counsel for the parties, no case is made out for interference U/s 438 Cr.P.C.
The present anticipatory bail application is disposed of with a direction that the applicant shall surrender before the concerned court below within one month from today and in case a regular bail application is filed, the same be decided in view of the law laid down by the Supreme Court in case of Satender Kumar Antil (supra).

7. For the period of one month from today or till the time of surrender of the applicant before the concerned court below, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant,
in the above case.

Order Date :- 16.4.2024 Vikas (Justice Krishan Pahal)
